files.content: HfieldInputs read-only input + HfieldView/HfieldParams views + HfieldError + resolve_hfield (validation only, no panic)
#[path = "hfield.rs"] pub mod hfield; module mount + doc note
pub use context::params::hfield::{HfieldError, HfieldInputs, HfieldParams, HfieldView, resolve_hfield};
10 host-only unit tests covering all acceptance cases

ruling_a.measured_conflict: RENDER_FIELDS has 116 specs and no hfield fields; RenderFields::field("hfield_*") is always None; RenderFields::new cannot inject extra fields; src/model/render.rs is a 500-line redline file outside this card scope; src/io/render.rs reads only the 116 fields from the native render_stage
ruling_a.decision: signature changed to resolve_hfield(&HfieldInputs); HfieldInputs is defined in src/render/context/hfield.rs; the render-side hfield data channel is delegated to 2026-10-28-render-bvh-r05-hfield-channel (proposed, S2 prerequisite); S2 data-source adapter gets its own card

equivalence_map.card: five fields must be provided simultaneously
equivalence_map.implemented: HfieldInputs five Options; any_present/all_present/first_missing; partial -> HfieldError::MissingField{field}
MissingField names the first missing field (hfield_size/hfield_nrow/hfield_ncol/hfield_adr/hfield_data)
strong-typed HfieldInputs handles types at compile time; runtime shape mismatch is size.len() != 4*nhfield -> LengthMismatch (test size_shape_mismatch_is_rejected)
nhfield = nrow.len(); three lengths must match else LengthMismatch{field,expected,actual}
per-entry adr+span <= data.len() plus explicit sum(span) <= data.len() (overlapping adr covered; else LengthMismatch)
all None or all empty slices -> Ok(None)
checked_mul/checked_add -> CountOverflow{field}; unreachable for i32 products on 64-bit usize, defensive only
no unwrap on user data, no index OOB, try_reserve_exact failure -> CountOverflow

equivalence_map.card: single copy (no nworld read, no per-world duplication)
equivalence_map.implemented: HfieldInputs has no nworld; resolve_hfield takes no world argument; view count == nhfield

validation_matrix: all None -> Ok(None); any Some with others None -> MissingField
ncol.len() != nrow.len() or adr.len() != nrow.len() -> LengthMismatch
nrow<=0 || ncol<=0 -> NonPositiveRowsCols; span = checked nrow*ncol
success -> HfieldParams{data, hfields}; data_of(index) returns the height slice

tests.note: the original card's 'kind mismatch' case is carried by size_shape_mismatch_is_rejected (size.len() != 4*nhfield), per ruling A

redlines.hfield_bvh_id_slot: still the existing placeholder upload [0u32, 0]; slot semantics unchanged in this slice

single_copy.rule: hfield static arrays are single-copy (no nworld read, no per-world duplication)

uncovered: render-side hfield data channel not wired (RENDER_FIELDS/io/render.rs/native model_probe.cpp have no hfield); delegated to 2026-10-28-render-bvh-r05-hfield-channel (proposed, S2 prerequisite)
S2 data-source adapter (build HfieldInputs from existing collision/volume inputs) gets its own card
device-side hfield BVH and kernel intersection not implemented (S2); hfield_bvh_id slot semantics unchanged
no upstream 2D numeric/equivalence verification; no window verdict in this slice
